newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline weaker with futures, barge supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline weaker with futures, barge supply.

text.p: NWE gasoline was weaker on Friday as futures eased amid healthy supply in the barge market, traders said.
Eurograde barges started the day offered at $202 fob ARA and slowly slipped. Barges were heard sold by a single trader at $201, $199 and $198.25 fob ARA.
Regular barge trade was heard at $189 fob ARA and were assessed by the end of the day at $186/$188.
A French refiner was heard having bought a 98/88 gasoline cargo on Thursday at $19 over premium barge quotes, cif southern France. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
